import json,os,tempfile
import numpy as np
import examples.huggingface.validate_curvature as validation
from examples.huggingface.rms_audit import division_control
out='/tmp/onnax-real-causal-ggn-audit'
os.makedirs(out,exist_ok=False)
original_reference=validation.reference_product
original_check=validation._check
controls=[]
def reference(*args,**kwargs):
    baseline=original_reference(*args,**kwargs)
    with division_control(args[0]) as count:
        controls.extend(original_reference(*args,**kwargs))
    print(json.dumps({'diagnostic':'sqrt_div_control','normalizations':count}),flush=True)
    return baseline
def metrics(actual,expected):
    rows=[]
    for a,b in zip(actual,expected,strict=True):
        delta=a-b
        rows.append({'shape':list(a.shape),'max_abs':float(np.max(np.abs(delta))),
                     'relative_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(delta.ravel())/max(float(np.linalg.norm(b.ravel())),1e-30)),
                     'violations':int(np.count_nonzero(np.abs(delta)>1e-6+1e-4*np.abs(b))),
                     'elements':a.size})
    return rows
def check(actual,expected):
    report={'stock_transformers':metrics(actual,expected),'sqrt_div_control':metrics(actual,controls),
            'curvature':float(actual[0]),'reference_curvature':float(expected[0]),
            'control_curvature':float(controls[0]),'rtol':1e-4,'atol':1e-6}
    with open(os.path.join(out,'diagnostic.json'),'w') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2)
    np.savez(os.path.join(out,'products.npz'),**{f'{name}_{i}':v for name,values in [('onnx',actual),('reference',expected),('control',controls)] for i,v in enumerate(values)})
    print(json.dumps({k:sum(row['violations'] for row in report[k]) for k in ['stock_transformers','sqrt_div_control']}),flush=True)
    return original_check(actual,expected)
validation.reference_product=reference
validation._check=check
validation.run(os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(),'curvature-audit'),real=True,provider='mlx',target_nodes=1024,library='/tmp/onnax-shape-vector-runtime/libonnxruntime_mlx_ep.dylib')
